content:
**Yao Guai Meat** is a consumable in *Fallout 76*.

A piece of raw meat from the body of a Yao Guai. It can be consumed raw to satisfy a very large amount of hunger with a very high dose of Radiation and high chance for disease or can be cooked for additional benefits. Collecting five meat is also an optional objective during the daily quest Daily: Thrill of the Grill.
